reason:
Confirmed by measurement. I built the branch CSS in a throwaway worktree (removed after) and rendered the exact class strings of parts.tsx 148-165 inside the real Card wrapper (`flex min-h-96 flex-col overflow-hidden`, grid `lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_17rem]`) in headless Chrome at 1280 px. Card spans 24-972. Row 1 (source 'semantic-scholar', 150-char URL with no space): chip clientWidth 62, scrollWidth 76, height 38 (wraps at the hyphen and still overflows w-16); query span clientWidth 749, scrollWidth 1281, so the URL paints over the result and past the card edge. Row 2 (result sentence of about 190 characters): query span width 0, height 40; result span left 129, right 1440, which is 468 px past the card edge, and Card's overflow-hidden cuts it. A normal row (short source, spaced query, short result) lays out correctly. The cause is as the reviewer states: the text span has min-w-0 but no truncate or break-words, and the result span is shrink-0 with no max width, so its flex basis is max-content. The spec (docs/spec/index.html 391-395) uses minmax(0,1fr) plus ellipsis on the query.

Reachability: the long unbroken query is reachable today with the demo worker. demoWorker.ts:52-53 puts task.title in row.text, and the title is the text the user types. A user who pastes a long URL as the goal gets the overflow. The long result and the long source are not produced by any current worker (demo emits 'demo', '3 sources', 'nothing'; traceContract uses 'arxiv', 'oeis'), but StepRow in packages/contracts/src/sessions.ts is plain `string` with no length limit, and the sibling delegate row in the same file already uses `truncate` (parts.tsx:194), so the search row is the inconsistent one. No data is lost on the server and the fix is two or three Tailwind classes. Severity should-fix is correct: not a blocker, not a nit, because one branch of the scenario is reachable now from user input and the cut text has no scrollbar and no title.
